description:
LOCATED AT JEFF WYLER VW OF DUBLIN
This 2025 Volkswagen Tiguan 2.0T SE in Black offers the reliability and performance you expect from a well-engineered compact SUV, backed by Volkswagen's Certified Pre-Owned program.

- 2.0L TSI DOHC engine with 8-speed automatic transmission and AWD
- Panoramic sunroof for an open, airy cabin experience
- Heated front seats with perforated V-Tex leatherette surfaces
- MIB4 composition media touchscreen with SiriusXM 360L satellite radio
- Exterior parking camera rear for convenient maneuvering
- 19 two-tone machined alloy wheels
- Front dual zone automatic temperature control
- Power liftgate for easy cargo access
- Speed-sensing steering for responsive handling
- Fully automatic headlights with delay-off feature
- Leather shift knob
- Rain sensing wipers

With 22 city MPG and 30 highway MPG, this Tiguan balances efficiency with capability, making it suitable for both daily commutes and weekend adventures. The 2.0T engine delivers responsive performance when you need it, while the eight-speed automatic transmission provides smooth gear transitions in all driving conditions. All-wheel drive enhances traction and stability across varied road surfaces.

The interior combines comfort and functionality with heated front seats, dual-zone climate control, and a power-adjustable driver's seat. The MIB4 touchscreen infotainment system with SiriusXM 360L connectivity keeps you informed and entertained during every drive. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls and a trip computer put essential information at your fingertips.

Safety is prioritized with a comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, anti-lock braking, and a low tire pressure warning system. The four-wheel independent suspension absorbs road imperfections while maintaining composure through corners. An emergency communication system via VW Car-Net Safe & Secure provides added peace of mind for five years.

As a Volkswagen Certified Pre-Owned vehicle, this Tiguan includes a 100+ point dealer inspection, ensuring it meets our rigorous standards. You'll receive a CARFAX vehicle history report, roadside assistance for two years, and a $50 warranty deductible. An additional two years or 24,000 miles of coverage extends your protection, along with a complimentary three-month SiriusXM trial to enjoy your favorite programming.

The Tiguan's practicality shines with a split-folding rear seat, power liftgate, and rear window wiper. Heated door mirrors with turn signal indicators and an auto-dimming rearview mirror enhance visibility in all conditions. Panoramic sunroof adds an upscale touch to your daily experience.

We invite you to schedule a test drive and discover how this Tiguan delivers the blend of German engineering, practical features, and peace of mind you deserve.
